businessGoal: Allow visitors to find products within specific categories.

scenarios.goal: Verify that clicking on a category name displays the category page.
Verify that the category name is shown as the page title on the category page.
Verify that only products from the selected category are displayed on the category page.

manual.reason: The story involves visible browser behaviors and product display.

api.reason: The story does not mention any API interactions or capabilities.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible content and interactions on the UI.
